title: Polish–Ottoman War (1633–1634)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Polish–Ottoman War (1633–1634)", at revision 1380605068, opens: "The Polish–Ottoman War of 1633–1634 was a military conflict between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Ottoman Empire, fought primarily by the forces of the Polish Crown under Grand Crown Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q74302, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
